posts.text: 🇺🇸 UNITED STATES: American Auto Shipping Database Allegedly Exposed via Misconfigured Firebase An underground forum post claims a Firebase database belonging to American Auto Shipping was left publicly accessible, allegedly exposing customer information and internal application data. * The threat actor claims the exposed database contained approximately 59,278 customer email addresses and 39,454 phone numbers. * The post further alleges exposure of 378 vehicle shipping orders containing customer information and delivery details. * The actor also claims the database included internal API endpoints, GraphQL queries, and application configuration data. * The listing references a second organization, Cruise Control Auto Transport, as allegedly sharing the same exposed environment. * The actor alleges the Firebase instance permitted both read and write access, although this claim has not been independently verified. Analyst Note: The claims originate from an underground forum posting and have not been independently confirmed by Daily Dark Web. The allegation of exposed payment card data and unrestricted write access remains unverified and should be treated cautiously pending confirmation from the affected organizations or additional technical evidence. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #USA
posts.text_zh: 🇺🇸 美國：American Auto Shipping 資料庫據稱透過錯誤配置的 Firebase 暴露 一篇地下論壇帖子聲稱屬於 American Auto Shipping 的 Firebase 資料庫被公開訪問，據稱洩露了客戶資訊和內部應用程式資料。 * 威脅行為者聲稱暴露的資料庫包含約 59,278 個客戶電子郵件地址和 39,454 個電話號碼。 * 該貼文進一步聲稱，包含客戶資訊和交付詳細資訊的 378 份車輛運輸訂單被曝光。 * 該攻擊者還聲稱該資料庫包括內部 API 端點、GraphQL 查詢和應用程式配置資料。 * 該清單引用了第二個組織 Cruise Control Auto Transport，據稱該組織共享相同的暴露環境。 * 攻擊者聲稱 Firebase 實例允許讀取和寫入訪問，但這一說法尚未得到獨立驗證。分析師註：這些說法源自地下論壇的帖子，尚未得到《每日暗網》的獨立證實。關於暴露支付卡資料和不受限制的寫入訪問的指控尚未得到證實，應謹慎對待，等待受影響組織的確認或其他技術證據。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #USA

posts.text: 🚨🇺🇸 Allstate-branded staging CRM data allegedly exposed through misconfigured Firebase database ⠀ A forum actor claims to have discovered a publicly accessible Firebase Realtime Database tied to an Allstate-branded tax preparation and client management platform. The actor says the staging environment allowed unauthenticated read and write access. ⠀ The exposed data allegedly includes: ⠀ • 968 Stripe transactions totaling approximately $182,830 • 20 Stripe production customer identifiers • Seven business accounts with tax and incorporation information • Eleven user profiles containing names, emails, phone numbers and Social Security numbers • Session, ID and refresh tokens • Nine SMS threads containing 26 messages between agents and clients • Tax return documents and other conversation attachments • Eleven employee pay periods with hours worked • Six Firebase Storage download tokens • Billing records, invoice identifiers and payment statuses ⠀ The actor claims write access was tested across five database endpoints, potentially allowing records, accounts, conversations and payment information to be modified. A database export and supporting files were also advertised for download. ⠀ The post attributes the environment to Allstate, but the displayed records reference Allstate Tax LLC and other tax preparation clients. The relationship to Allstate Corporation has not been independently confirmed. ⠀ This claim is currently unverified. ⠀ 💥 Get early visibility into underground claims, including unblurred screenshots, before they turn into headlines: http://darkwebinformer.com/pricing
posts.text_zh: 🚨🇺🇸 Allstate 品牌的臨時 CRM 資料據稱透過錯誤配置的 Firebase 資料庫暴露 ⠀ 一位論壇參與者聲稱發現了一個與 Allstate 品牌的稅務準備和客戶管理平台相關聯的可公開訪問的 Firebase 即時資料庫。該演員表示，暫存環境允許未經身份驗證的讀寫存取。 ⠀ 據稱，暴露的資料包括： ⠀ • 968 筆 Stripe 交易，總計約 182,830 美元 • 20 個 Stripe 生產客戶識別碼 • 7 個包含稅務和公司信息的企業帳戶 • 11 個包含姓名、電子郵件、電話號碼和社會安全號碼的用戶配置文件 • 7 條報稅表文件和其他對話附件 • 11 個員工薪資週期（包含工作時間） • 6 個 Firebase 儲存下載代幣 •帳單記錄、發票識別碼和付款狀態 ⠀ 參與者聲稱寫入存取權限已在五個資料庫端點上進行了測試，可能允許修改記錄、帳戶、對話和付款資訊。也公佈了資料庫匯出和支援文件可供下載。 ⠀ 這篇文章將環境歸因於 Allstate，但顯示的記錄引用了 Allstate Tax LLC 和其他稅務準備客戶。與好事達公司的關係尚未獲得獨立證實。 ⠀ 此說法目前尚未被證實。 ⠀ 💥 在地下索賠成為頭條新聞之前儘早了解它們，包括清晰的螢幕截圖：http://darkwebinformer.com/pricing

posts.text: 🐧 Linux's Staging Area To Now Reject LLM-Generated Patches, Except For Real Security Fixes Linux kernel maintainer Greg Kroah-Hartman has announced an urgent round of stable kernel updates, continuing the project's rapid patch cycle to address important bug fixes, stability improvements, and security-related issues across supported kernel branches. * Multiple supported Linux kernel branches are receiving synchronized stable updates. * The releases include a combination of security fixes, reliability improvements, and regression corrections. * Linux distributions and downstream vendors are expected to incorporate these updates into their own security releases. * System administrators should prioritize applying the latest stable kernels once they become available through their distribution. **Analyst Note:** Even when individual advisories do not disclose a specific critical CVE, stable Linux kernel updates frequently contain security-relevant fixes that may later be assigned CVEs or become publicly understood. Organizations should treat timely kernel updates as a core component of vulnerability management rather than waiting for high-profile security advisories. Source: https://lore.kernel.org/all/2026080354-skater-urgent-31b2@gregkh/T/ #Linux #Kernel #CyberSecurity #DDW
posts.text_zh: 🐧 Linux 的暫存區域現在拒絕 LLM 產生的補丁，除了真正的安全修復 Linux 核心維護者 Greg Kroah-Hartman 宣布了一輪緊急的穩定核心更新，繼續該專案的快速補丁週期，以解決受支援的核心分支中的重要錯誤修復、穩定性改進和安全相關問題。 * 多個受支援的 Linux 核心分支正在接收同步穩定更新。 * 這些版本包括安全修復、可靠性改進和回歸修正的組合。 * Linux 發行版和下游供應商預計會將這些更新合併到他們自己的安全版本中。 * 一旦最新的穩定核心通過其發行版可用，系統管理員應優先應用它們。 **分析師附註：** 即使個別公告沒有披露特定的關鍵 CVE，穩定的 Linux 核心更新也經常包含與安全相關的修復程序，這些修復程序稍後可能會被分配 CVE 或被公眾理解。組織應將及時的核心更新視為漏洞管理的核心組成部分，而不是等待高調的安全建議。來源：https://lore.kernel.org/all/2026080354-skater-urgent-31b2@gregkh/T/ #Linux #Kernel #Cyber​​Security #DDW

posts.text: 🚨 Microsoft Calls for a Fundamental Rethink of Security in the AI Era Microsoft has published a new security vision arguing that traditional cybersecurity models are no longer sufficient as AI agents become capable of making decisions, accessing enterprise data, and interacting autonomously with digital systems. * Microsoft says AI is rapidly becoming a new class of digital identity that must be governed like human users and service accounts. * The company advocates for Zero Trust principles to extend beyond people and devices to include AI agents and autonomous systems. * Organizations are encouraged to implement least-privilege access, continuous identity verification, and real-time monitoring for AI-driven workflows. * The blog also highlights the need for secure AI development, governance, and visibility into agent actions as enterprises increasingly deploy AI across business operations. **Analyst Note:** AI is changing cybersecurity from protecting applications to governing autonomous decision-makers. As organizations adopt AI agents with access to sensitive systems and data, identity, authorization, monitoring, and auditability will become just as important for AI as they are for human users. Source: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/07/27/rethinking-security-for-the-age-of-ai/ #AI #CyberSecurity #ZeroTrust #DDW
posts.text_zh: 🚨 微软呼吁对人工智能时代的安全进行根本性反思 微软发布了新的安全愿景，认为随着人工智能代理能够做出决策、访问企业数据以及与数字系统自主交互，传统的网络安全模型已不再足够。 * 微软表示，人工智能正在迅速成为一种新型数字身份，必须像人类用户和服务帐户一样进行管理。 * 該公司倡導零信任原則，將其擴展到人員和設備之外，包括人工智慧代理和自治系統。 * 鼓勵組織對人工智慧驅動的工作流程實施最低權限存取、持續身份驗證和即時監控。 * 该博客还强调，随着企业越来越多地在业务运营中部署人工智能，需要安全的人工智能开发、治理和代理操作的可见性。 **分析师注：** 人工智能正在改变网络安全，从保护应用程序到管理自主决策者。随着组织采用能够访问敏感系统和数据的人工智能代理，身份、授权、监控和可审计性对于人工智能来说将变得与人类用户一样重要。来源：https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/07/27/rethinking-security-for-the-age-of-ai/ #AI #Cyber​​Security #ZeroTrust #DDW

posts.text: 🇮🇳 INDIA: Extramarks Backup Allegedly Offered on Underground Forum A threat actor has published a post claiming to possess a full backup of Extramarks, an Indian EdTech platform, and is advertising the data on an underground forum. * The seller claims the archive includes the company's source code, core application files, databases, media uploads, SEO assets, configuration files, and server logs. * According to the post, the compressed archive is approximately 1.8 GB. * The listing describes the package as a "full backup," potentially exposing both application infrastructure and backend data if authentic. * No technical evidence or proof of compromise was provided beyond the forum advertisement. Analyst Note: At the time of writing, there is no public confirmation from Extramarks that a compromise has occurred. The claims originate solely from an underground forum post and should be treated as unverified until independently validated. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #India
posts.text_zh: 🇮🇳 印度：地下論壇據稱提供 Extramarks 備份 威脅行為者發布了一篇帖子，聲稱擁有印度教育科技平台 Extramarks 的完整備份，並在地下論壇上宣傳這些數據。 * 賣家聲稱存檔包括公司的原始碼、核心應用程式檔案、資料庫、媒體上傳、SEO 資產、設定檔和伺服器日誌。 * 根據該帖子，壓縮檔案約為 1.8 GB。 * 該清單將該套件描述為“完整備份”，如果真實的話，可能會暴露應用程式基礎架構和後端資料。 * 除論壇廣告外，未提供任何技術證據或妥協證明。分析師附註：截至撰寫本文時，Extramarks 尚未公開確認已發生外洩。這些說法僅源自地下論壇帖子，在經過獨立驗證之前應被視為未經驗證。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #India

posts.text: 🇹🇷 TURKEY: SMS Platform Database Allegedly Offered for Sale on Underground Forum An underground forum user is advertising the sale of what is claimed to be the full backend database of a Turkish company providing SMS services, school management solutions, and software platforms. * The seller describes it as a one-time sale and claims the database exceeds 70 GB. * Sample data suggests the database contains customer, school, and messaging platform records. * Allegedly exposed fields include user IDs, organization information, administrator details, phone numbers, email addresses, password hashes, API usernames and passwords, SMS configuration settings, attendance notifications, parent/student messaging content, and company account information. * The advertisement also references API keys, webhook settings, registration records, credit information, and SMS campaign data. Analyst Note: The forum post provides sample records and claims to offer the complete production database. However, the identity of the affected organization, the source of the data, and the authenticity of the alleged breach have not been independently verified. The claim should be treated as unconfirmed until corroborated by the affected company or additional technical evidence. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Turkey
posts.text_zh: 🇹🇷土耳其：據稱在地下論壇上出售短信平台數據庫 一名地下論壇用戶正在宣傳出售據稱是一家土耳其公司的完整後端數據庫，該公司提供短信服務、學校管理解決方案和軟體平台。 * 賣家將其描述為一次性銷售，並聲稱資料庫超過 70 GB。 * 範例資料顯示資料庫包含客戶、學校和訊息平台記錄。 * 據稱暴露的欄位包括使用者 ID、組織資訊、管理員詳細資料、電話號碼、電子郵件地址、密碼雜湊、API 使用者名稱和密碼、簡訊配置設定、出勤通知、家長/學生訊息內容和公司帳戶資訊。 * 廣告也引用了 API 金鑰、webhook 設定、註冊記錄、信用資訊和 SMS 活動資料。分析師註釋：論壇貼文提供了範例記錄和聲明，以提供完整的生產資料庫。然而，受影響組織的身份、資料來源以及涉嫌違規行為的真實性尚未得到獨立核實。在受影響的公司或其他技術證據證實之前，該索賠應被視為未經證實。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Turkey

posts.text: 🇫🇷 FRANCE: Inserm User Database Allegedly Leaked on Underground Forum An underground forum user is advertising what they claim is a database containing user information associated with Inserm (French National Institute of Health and Medical Research). * The seller claims the dataset contains approximately 189,997 user records. * According to the listing, the data is provided in JSON format. * While the screenshot does not expose the complete schema, the post advertises a user database rather than isolated documents or credentials. * At the time of writing, no official statement from Inserm has been identified acknowledging the alleged incident. Analyst Note: The forum post advertises what is claimed to be an Inserm user database but provides limited technical evidence beyond record counts and sample references. The authenticity, source, and scope of the alleged dataset have not been independently verified and should be treated as an unconfirmed breach claim pending further validation. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #France
posts.text_zh: 🇫🇷 法國：Inserm 用戶資料庫據稱在地下論壇上洩露 一名地下論壇用戶正在宣傳他們聲稱包含與 Inserm（法國國家健康與醫學研究所）相關的用戶資訊的資料庫。 * 賣家聲稱該資料集包含約 189,997 筆使用者記錄。 * 根據清單，資料以 JSON 格式提供。 * 雖然螢幕截圖沒有公開完整的架構，但該貼文宣傳的是使用者資料庫，而不是孤立的文件或憑證。 * 截至撰寫本文時，Inserm 尚未發表正式聲明承認所稱事件。分析師註釋：該論壇貼文宣傳了所謂的 Inserm 用戶資料庫，但除了記錄計數和樣本參考之外，還提供了有限的技術證據。所指控資料集的真實性、來源和範圍尚未經過獨立驗證，應被視為未經確認的違規索賠，有待進一步驗證。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #France

posts.text: 🇺🇸 UNITED STATES: Cushman & Wakefield Data Resurfaces on Underground Forum An underground forum post is redistributing a dataset previously attributed to the May 2026 extortion incident involving global commercial real estate firm Cushman & Wakefield. * The listing references the previously disclosed ShinyHunters extortion campaign against Cushman & Wakefield. * According to the post, the dataset primarily contains business contact information, including names, email addresses, job titles, phone numbers, physical addresses, and salutations. * The forum advertisement cites approximately 310,400 affected email addresses and references the dataset's inclusion in Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) following the 2026 incident. * The post appears to be a redistribution of previously leaked data rather than evidence of a newly disclosed compromise. posts.text: 🚨 Alleged http://Zigzag.kr Breach Exposes 12.5M User Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that 12.5 million user records from the South Korean platform http://zigzag.kr were compromised in a breach dated July 21, 2026. The listing alleges that the stolen database contains sensitive personal information, including names, email addresses, phone numbers, physical addresses, and password hashes for a significant portion of the site's user base. According to the post, the exposed dataset includes the following fields: * ZIGZAGUUID * username * full_name * email * password_hash * role * status * gender * birth_date * phone * postal_code * address_line1 * address_line2 * reward_points * last_login * created_at * updated_at * email_verified * email_opt_in * sms_opt_in * profile_public The actor, identified in previous forum activity as "Evil_Zone," has a history of distributing large volumes of stealer logs and combolists on underground markets such as http://XForums.st. Past listings by this actor have included hundreds of thousands of lines of credentials and session tokens, suggesting a focus on bulk credential harvesting rather than targeted ransomware operations. The current listing provides a sample link and an alleged session ID to verify the authenticity of the data dump. Zigzag is a popular social networking service in South Korea, often used for anonymous communication and community discussions. If the breach is authentic, the exposure of password hashes and personal contact details could facilitate credential stuffing attacks, phishing campaigns, and identity theft against millions of users. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or the company.

posts.text: 🚨 ZoomInfo B2B Data Listing Allegedly Exposes 185M Records A darkweb forum post claims to offer a dataset containing 185 million business-to-business (B2B) records allegedly sourced from ZoomInfo. The listing, posted on an underground marketplace, asserts that the data was compiled from publicly available indexes and includes sensitive professional and personal information for individuals across the United States. According to the post, the dataset includes the following fields: * First and last names * Business and personal email addresses * Job titles, seniority levels, and departments * Mobile phone numbers and LinkedIn URLs * Company names, domains, phone numbers, and addresses * Primary industry classifications and SIC codes * Estimated company revenue and employee counts The actor alleges that many of the emails in the dump had not been previously leaked and that the data covers various industries. The post states that the data is being sold for Monero (XMR) only and provides a link to a file hosted on http://biteblob.com. ZoomInfo is a major provider of business intelligence data, widely used by sales and marketing teams for lead generation. A breach of this scale could significantly impact privacy and enable targeted phishing or social engineering campaigns against corporate professionals. The threat actor behind the post has a history of distributing large volumes of credentials and stealer logs on forums such as http://XForums.st, often under aliases like 'Evil_Zone'. At the time of reporting, ZoomInfo has not commented on the incident, and the authenticity of the 185 million record claim has not been independently verified.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 42M Baemin Records for Sale on Darkweb A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor is allegedly offering a database containing personal data of 42 million users from Baemin, a major South Korean food delivery platform, for $800. The listing, posted on an underground forum by a user identified as 'feijo', claims to include sensitive customer information such as full names, email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses. According to the post, the dataset includes the following fields: * user_id * full_name * email * phone * phone_verified * auth_provider * address * city * district * postal_code * signup_date * last_order_date * orders * cancelled_orders * total_spent_krw * favorite_cuisine * baemin_club_status * baemin_club_since * account_status * device_model * os_version * app_version * updated_at Baemin is one of the largest food delivery services in South Korea, operating under Coupang, a major e-commerce conglomerate. The exposure of such a large volume of user data, including precise location information and spending habits, could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns, identity theft, and physical stalking if the leak is authentic. The threat actor 'feijo' has a history of selling stolen credentials and stealer logs on underground forums like http://XForums.st. Previous activity includes listings for "Fresh Private HQ ULP LOGS" and Twitter combo lists, suggesting a focus on harvesting and monetizing compromised account data rather than large-scale infrastructure breaches. This pattern indicates the actor likely acquired this database through initial access brokers or credential stuffing rather than a direct hack of Baemin's core infrastructure. At the time of reporting, Baemin or Coupang has not issued a public statement regarding this alleged breach, and the incident has not been independently verified.

According to the listing on an underground forum, the leak includes advanced radar data and other sensitive military files. The post, dated August 3, 2026, claims that these materials have been made available, potentially exposing critical defense infrastructure details. The threat actor has a documented history of targeting military and government entities in other regions. Previous activity on underground forums shows 'mosad' advertising the sale of bulk data related to China's People's Liberation Army (PLA), specifically targeting the Army Rocket Force, Foreign Affairs divisions, and Cyberforce units. This pattern suggests a focus on high-value state secrets and defense-related intelligence. Brazil's Ministry of Defense oversees the country's armed forces and national security strategy, making it a high-profile target for espionage and cyber-espionage campaigns. If authentic, the exposure of advanced radar specifications could compromise Brazil's air defense capabilities and reveal vulnerabilities to potential adversaries. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from the Brazilian government. #DataLeak #Brazil #MinistryOfDefense #MilitaryEspionage #DarkWeb #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Android Local Privilege Escalation Exploit for Android 16 Claimed on Underground Forum A post on an underground forum claims the availability of a local privilege escalation (LPE) exploit targeting Android 16. The actor alleges that the vulnerability has been tested on Samsung Galaxy S25 devices running the latest operating system version, with a security patch level dated June 2026. The post specifies that the vulnerability is present in devices patched as of June 2026, suggesting that manufacturers have not yet released a fix for this specific flaw. No proof-of-concept code or additional technical details were provided in the initial thread. Android 16 represents the latest major release of Google's mobile operating system. If authentic, this exploit could enable threat actors to bypass security controls on high-end smartphones, potentially leading to data theft, surveillance, or ransomware deployment on compromised devices. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified.

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Pakistan Telecom Breach Exposes 30M Citizens' Data for Sale A listing on an underground forum claims that personal data belonging to over 30 million Pakistani citizens has been stolen from a telecommunications provider and is now available for purchase. The post, dated August 2, 2026, alleges the sale of a database containing sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) linked to telecom subscribers. According to the listing, the dataset includes the following fields: * First Name * Last Name * National ID Number (CNIC Number) * Address The actor is reportedly asking $150 for access to the full database and provided a SHA-256 hash (057abdb0c54519cf95179a84e74e040729c94fc3bac92e176e70e4acb674ae8d07) as proof of sample availability. While the specific telecommunications company is not named in the thread, the inclusion of CNIC numbers—a mandatory identifier for all mobile registrations in Pakistan—suggests the data originates from one of the country's major carriers, such as Jazz, Telenor, Zong, or Ufone. If authentic, the exposure of national ID numbers alongside addresses poses significant risks for identity theft, fraud, and targeted phishing campaigns against millions of users. Pakistan's telecom sector is highly regulated, and such a breach would likely trigger investigations by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA). At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified, and no official statement has been issued by any Pakistani telecom operator regarding this incident. #DataBreach #Pakistan #TelecomSecurity #IdentityTheft #DarkWeb #PII #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: I am filled with disappointment. Last time on Dragon Ball Z, I announced my boredom with malware development, hence I decided to pivot to malware defense. I began by taking apart YARA to understand how it works, and making my own little silly YARA scanner. Whatever. I then began reviewing the malware people discovered in the wild. I have reviewed hundreds of malwares, and many also non-malwares. Unfortunately, I am at the point where I am no longer finding original goop. It is the same malware campaigns, different person sending it, different compromised webhosts, or slightly tweaked SHA256 hashes. I now feel the existential dread my blue team colleagues feel. It is the same gunk everyday. The gunk is persistent. The gunk is infinite and vast. The gunk is like an ocean of gunk.
posts.text_zh: 我心裡充滿了失望。上次在《七龍珠 Z》中，我宣布了我對惡意軟體開發的厭倦，因此我決定轉向​​惡意軟體防禦。我先拆開 YARA 以了解它的工作原理，並製作了我自己的小而愚蠢的 YARA 掃描儀。任何。然後我開始審查人們在野外發現的惡意軟體。我審查了數百種惡意軟體，還有許多非惡意軟體。不幸的是，我現在已經找不到原始的東西了。這是相同的惡意軟體活動，不同的發送者，不同的受損網路主機，或稍微調整的 SHA256 雜湊值。我現在感受到了我的藍隊同事所感受到的存在主義恐懼。每天都是同樣的垃圾。黏稠物是持久的。黏稠物是無限而巨大的。泥濘就像泥濘的海洋。

posts.text: 📱 UPDATE: Apple Says Telegram Was Temporarily Removed Over CSAM Policy Violation Apple has clarified why Telegram briefly disappeared from the App Store. * Apple told Bloomberg the app was temporarily removed after a review identified content that violated its policies prohibiting Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM). * According to Apple, Telegram restored access after promptly removing the offending content and banning the user responsible. * Telegram has since returned to the App Store. * Telegram CEO Pavel Durov responded on X, saying: "I'm sure this stance will be applied equally to all other apps in the store, in the future right? Apple" Analyst Note: The removal appears to have been driven by App Store content moderation rather than a platform-wide security issue or regulatory enforcement. The incident also highlights the increasing pressure app stores are placing on messaging platforms to rapidly address illegal content. Sources * Bloomberg #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Telegram
posts.text_zh: 📱 更新：蘋果稱 Telegram 因違反 CSAM 政策而被暫時下架 蘋果已澄清 Telegram 短暫從 App Store 中消失的原因。 * 蘋果告訴彭博社，在審查發現內容違反其禁止兒童性虐待材料 (CSAM) 的政策後，該應用程式已被暫時刪除。 * 據蘋果公司稱，Telegram 在及時刪除違規內容並禁止相關用戶後恢復了存取權限。 * Telegram 此後已返回 App Store。 * Telegram 首席執行官 Pavel Durov 在 X 上回應稱：“我確信這一立場將同樣適用於商店中的所有其他應用程序，未來是吧？蘋果” 分析師注：此次刪除似乎是由 App Store 內容審核驅動的，而不是平台範圍的安全問題或監管。該事件還凸顯了應用程式商店對訊息平台施加的越來越大的壓力，以快速解決非法內容。來源*彭博#DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Telegram

posts.text: 🇪🇸 Spain: Alleged Cromakit Customer and User Database Shared for Free A cybercrime forum user has published what they claim is a database associated with http://Cromakit.es, a Spanish e-commerce business. * The listing appears to include customer order and billing records with names, company details, addresses, cities, postal codes, countries, phone numbers, and email addresses. * A second sample appears to contain website user-account data, including usernames, email addresses, registration details, activation keys, account status, and password-related fields. * The actor is distributing the alleged database through external download links rather than offering it for sale. * The post does not disclose the total number of records, the date of the alleged compromise, or the intrusion method. * The authenticity, recency, and completeness of the dataset have not been independently verified. Analyst Note: The presence of both commerce records and account tables could increase the risk of credential attacks, phishing, fraud, and customer impersonation. Password fields may be hashed rather than plaintext, but exposed hashes can still create risk where weak algorithms or reused passwords are involved. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Spain
posts.text_zh: 🇪🇸 西班牙：據稱免費共享 Cromakit 客戶和用戶資料庫 一名網路犯罪論壇用戶發布了他們聲稱與西班牙電子商務企業 http://Cromakit.es 相關的資料庫。 * 這份清單似乎包括客戶訂單和帳單記錄，其中包含姓名、公司詳細資料、地址、城市、郵遞區號、國家/地區、電話號碼和電子郵件地址。 * 第二個範例似乎包含網站使用者帳戶數據，包括使用者名稱、電子郵件地址、註冊詳細資料、啟動金鑰、帳戶狀態和密碼相關欄位。 * 攻擊者透過外部下載連結分發所謂的資料庫，而不是將其出售。 * 該貼文沒有透露記錄總數、涉嫌洩漏的日期或入侵方法。 * 資料集的真實性、最新性和完整性尚未經過獨立驗證。分析師註釋：商業記錄和帳戶表的存在可能會增加憑證攻擊、網路釣魚、詐欺和客戶冒充的風險。密碼欄位可能是散列的而不是純文字的，但暴露的雜湊仍然會在涉及弱演算法或重複使用的密碼時產生風險。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Spain

posts.text: 🇮🇳 India: DreamChild Parenting User Profiles Allegedly Leaked A threat actor has published what they claim is a database containing user profiles from DreamChild (http://dreamchild.in), an India-based prenatal wellness and parenting platform. * The post claims the dataset contains 64,122 user profiles. * According to the actor, the data includes names, phone numbers, IP addresses, device IDs, cities, regions, countries, languages, and device metadata. * The listing also references more than 54,000 unique device IDs, 35,000+ unique names, and 13,000+ phone numbers. * The dataset is reportedly shared in both JSON Lines and JSON formats and is being distributed publicly. * At the time of writing, there is no public confirmation from DreamChild or Anantam Life Science verifying the authenticity of the alleged leak. Analyst Note: Applications handling pregnancy, parenting, and health-related services often process highly sensitive personal information. If the claims are accurate, exposed user data could be leveraged for targeted phishing, identity theft, account compromise, and privacy violations. The authenticity and scope of the dataset should be independently verified before conclusions are drawn. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #India
posts.text_zh: 🇮🇳 印度：DreamChild 育兒用戶資料據稱遭洩露 威脅行為者發布了他們聲稱的資料庫，其中包含來自印度產前健康和育兒平台 DreamChild (http://dreamchild.in) 的用戶資料。 * 該貼文聲稱該資料集包含 64,122 個使用者個人資料。 * 據該行為者稱，這些數據包括姓名、電話號碼、IP 位址、設備 ID、城市、地區、國家、語言和設備元數據。 * 該清單還引用了超過 54,000 個唯一設備 ID、超過 35,000 個唯一名稱以及超過 13,000 個電話號碼。 * 據報道，該資料集以 JSON Lines 和 JSON 格式共享，並且正在公開分發。 * 截至本文撰寫時，DreamChild 或 Anantam Life Science 尚未公開確認所謂洩密事件的真實性。分析師註釋：處理懷孕、育兒和健康相關服務的應用程式通常會處理高度敏感的個人資訊。如果聲明準確，暴露的用戶資料可能會被用於有針對性的網路釣魚、身分盜竊、帳戶洩露和隱私侵犯。在得出結論之前，應獨立驗證資料集的真實性和範圍。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #India

posts.text: 🇺🇸 United States: STIIIZY Allegedly Listed by Everest Ransomware Group The Everest ransomware group has claimed an attack against California-based cannabis retailer STIIIZY, alleging the theft of customer and internal company data. * The threat actor claims approximately 420,000 records were obtained. * Allegedly exposed data includes customer account information, government-issued identification documents, medical cannabis cards, and internal documents. * Screenshots published on the leak site reference both databases and corporate documents. * At the time of writing, the claims have not been independently verified, and no official statement confirming the alleged compromise has been issued by STIIIZY. Analyst Note: Incidents affecting regulated cannabis businesses can expose particularly sensitive personal information, including identity documents and medical-related records. If confirmed, affected individuals could face elevated risks of identity theft, targeted phishing, and privacy violations. The authenticity and scope of the alleged leak should be independently validated. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #USA

posts.text: 🇫🇷 France: INSERM User Database Allegedly Shared on Cybercrime Forum A threat actor has advertised what they claim is a user database associated with INSERM (French National Institute of Health and Medical Research) on a cybercrime forum. * The post claims the dataset contains approximately 189,997 user records. * The actor states the data is provided in JSON format. * A screenshot displaying the INSERM branding accompanies the listing, although no detailed sample of the records is publicly shown. * At the time of writing, there is no public confirmation from INSERM or French authorities validating the authenticity of the alleged dataset. Analyst Note: Research institutions are attractive targets due to the sensitive nature of their user data, research activities, and collaborative networks. If authentic, the exposed information could enable phishing campaigns, account compromise attempts, and further attacks against affiliated researchers and partner organizations. The claims should be independently verified before conclusions are drawn. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #France

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 2 TB Falabella Chile Data on Darkweb A threat actor is allegedly offering for sale 2 terabytes of data stolen from Falabella Chile, one of Latin America's largest retail conglomerates. According to a listing on an underground forum, the breach occurred several months ago when the tenant of Falabella Chile was accessed, resulting in the compromise of databases and internal systems. The actor claims to have reviewed the data for over two months before initiating the sale. The post alleges that the exposed material includes documents extracted from SharePoint and internal repositories. The seller claims the following categories of data are included in the dump: * Active Directory reports * Registry export files (REGEDIT) * Various PDF documents The actor is reportedly asking for 0.65 BTC for the full dataset. Links to sample files were provided in the thread to demonstrate the authenticity of the leak. Falabella is a major player in the retail sector, operating numerous department stores and e-commerce platforms across Chile, Peru, Colombia, and Mexico. A breach of this scale could expose sensitive customer information, employee records, and proprietary business strategies if the claims are accurate. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Falabella or third-party security firms.

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Questrade Breach Exposes 152,000 Customer Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that a database containing personal information for 152,284 users of Questrade, a major Canadian investment platform, is being offered for sale. The listing, dated August 2, 2026, alleges that the data was obtained by a third party and provided to the seller for distribution. According to the post, the compromised dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) for each record. The seller lists the following data fields as exposed: * Full name (first and last) * Email address * Physical address (street, city, province, postal code) * Phone number * Gender * Internal identifiers (Questrade.LeadCheck, userType) Questrade Inc. is one of Canada’s largest online discount brokers, serving hundreds of thousands of retail investors. The exposure of such detailed contact information could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns, social engineering attacks, or identity theft against the affected individuals. The seller demands $300 USD for the database and requests proof of funds before providing access. The post explicitly states that the data was not breached by the poster but was acquired from a partner. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified, and Questrade has not issued a public statement regarding this specific incident.

posts.text: 🇰🇷 South Korea: Automotive Manufacturer Database Allegedly Offered for Sale A threat actor is advertising what they claim is a full infrastructure database dump belonging to South Korean automotive parts manufacturer Namyang Industrial Co., Ltd., now operating as Namyang Nexmo. * The seller claims the dataset originates from internal infrastructure rather than the public website. * Allegedly affected data includes manufacturing information, customer records, supplier and partner data, employer information, and internal business records. * The post claims 559 database tables totaling approximately 17.6 million rows and around 2.5 GB of CSV data. * The dataset is being advertised for sale for $40,000, with the actor claiming discounts for interested buyers. * There is currently no public confirmation from Namyang Nexmo that validates the authenticity of the claimed data. posts.text: 🇲🇽 Mexico: Alleged CDMX SUAC 0311 Citizen Database Advertised on Cybercrime Forum A threat actor is advertising what they claim is a database associated with Mexico City's SUAC 0311 citizen service platform. * The listing claims to contain 363,954 citizen records. * The sample displayed includes fields such as first name, paternal surname, maternal surname, RFC, address, municipality, state, street, gender, postal code, and telephone-related information. * The post identifies the target as SUAC 0311 (Locatel), a Mexico City government citizen-service system. * A contact channel is provided for interested parties, indicating the dataset is being offered for distribution. * The authenticity, origin, and scope of the alleged dataset have not been independently verified. Analyst Note: If authentic, exposure of citizen-service records could facilitate identity theft, phishing, and social engineering by combining contact details with government-related identifiers. Until confirmed by Mexican authorities or supported by independent technical evidence, this should be treated as an unverified breach claim. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Mexico

posts.text: 🇺🇸 United States: Alleged IPRO Customer Database Published on Cybercrime Forum A threat actor has published what they claim is a complete customer database associated with IPRO, an eDiscovery and legal data-management platform. * The listing claims the dataset contains approximately 60,000 records. * The sample appears to include customer account IDs, organization names, account status, addresses, country, customer type, payment terms, timestamps, and internal client-account identifiers. * The actor provided a download link and described the archive as IPRO’s full customer database. * Because IPRO serves law firms, corporations, and government organizations, authentic customer records could also reveal sensitive business relationships and client metadata. * The origin, completeness, and authenticity of the dataset have not been independently verified. Analyst Note: The sample appears focused on customer-account metadata rather than legal case files. Even so, exposure could support targeted phishing, vendor impersonation, and attacks against organizations identified as IPRO customers. The claim should remain classified as unverified pending confirmation from IPRO or independent technical validation. #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #IPRO

posts.name: MonThreat
posts.text: R to @MonThreat: 🚨 Update: Potential Connection Between Baltas Online Data Breach Claims and CRPxO Leak Site Activity A threat actor recently claimed on a well-known dark web forum to have compromised Baltas Online, a Turkish HR services provider, allegedly obtaining root-level access and exfiltrating more than 500 GB of data. According to the threat actor's post, the alleged dataset includes personnel records, executive psychometric assessments, personality analysis reports, candidate profiles, email archives, examination documents, interview recordings, internal notes, and source code. The threat actor further claimed that the affected data relates to more than 750 corporate clients in Türkiye and shared sample files as proof of access, including candidate evaluation documents, email archives, company contact lists, internal methodology materials, and assessment recordings. Following this claim, similarities were observed between the data types referenced in the Baltas Online breach post and the documents later published in connection with CRPxO victim listings. Multiple CRPxO samples were observed to contain Hogan Assessment reports, executive evaluation documents, and personnel assessment materials containing Baltaş Group branding. While a direct operational link between the forum threat actor and CRPxO has not been independently verified, the overlap in exposed document categories and assessment-related materials suggests a possible connection between the reported Baltas Online compromise and CRPxO's recent leak site activity.
posts.text_zh: R 致 @MonThreat：🚨 更新：Baltas Online 資料外洩聲明與 CRPxO 外洩網站活動之間的潛在聯繫 一名威脅行為者最近在一個知名暗網論壇上聲稱，他們已經入侵了土耳其人力資源服務提供商 Baltas Online，據稱獲得了根級訪問權限並洩露了超過 500 GB 的數據。根據威脅行為者的帖子，所謂的數據集包括人事記錄、高管心理測量評估、性格分析報告、候選人資料、電子郵件檔案、考試文件、面試錄音、內部筆記和源代碼。該威脅行為者進一步聲稱，受影響的數據與土耳其 750 多家企業客戶相關，並共享樣本文件作為訪問證明，包括候選人評估文件、電子郵件檔案、公司聯絡人清單、內部方法材料和評估記錄。在這項聲明之後，我們發現 Baltas Online 違規貼文中引用的資料類型與後來發布的與 CRPxO 受害者清單相關的文件之間存在相似之處。据观察，多个 CRPxO 样本均包含包含 Baltaş 集团品牌的 Hogan 评估报告、高管评估文件和人员评估材料。雖然論壇威脅行為者和 CRPxO 之間的直接操作聯繫尚未得到獨立驗證，但暴露的文檔類別和評估相關資料的重疊表明所報告的 Baltas Online 入侵與 CRPxO 最近的洩漏網站活動之間可能存在聯繫。

posts.text: 🚨 Emerging Ransomware Group CRPxO Lists Multiple High-Profile Turkish Organizations on Leak Site A ransomware group operating under the name CRPxO has recently launched its data leak site and started publishing victim claims. As of the latest observation, the group has listed 11 organizations operating in Türkiye across various sectors, including finance, defense, automotive, aviation, retail, insurance, media, and manufacturing. Multiple observed samples from CRPxO victim listings contain Hogan Assessment reports and executive evaluation documents. The identified documents include personality assessment results, behavioral analysis reports, and evaluation materials related to personnel assessment processes. The samples also contain Baltaş Group branding, suggesting that the exposed documents may be associated with executive assessment and talent evaluation services provided through Baltaş Group. Following the expiration of the countdown timer for several listed organizations, CRPxO stated that "the company owner doesn't care about their clients' or users' privacy and security." The threat actor also claimed that the related data would not be publicly released and would only be shared with individuals who directly contact the group. #Ransomware #Turkey #ThreatMon

posts.text: 🇪🇺 European Parliament Committee Member Targeted with Pegasus Spyware Citizen Lab has confirmed that a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) serving on the committee investigating spyware was infected with NSO Group's Pegasus spyware. * The victim is Daniel Freund, a German MEP and member of the European Parliament's PEGA follow-up committee, which investigates spyware abuse. * Citizen Lab's forensic analysis found evidence that his iPhone was compromised with Pegasus in 2024. * The compromise occurred while the committee was examining the use of commercial spyware against journalists, activists, politicians, and civil society. * The report underscores the continued use of sophisticated mercenary spyware against individuals involved in oversight, accountability, and democratic institutions. * Citizen Lab has not publicly attributed the operation to a specific government. Analyst Note: This case demonstrates that commercial spyware continues to be deployed against high-profile political targets, including officials responsible for investigating spyware misuse. It reinforces concerns over the growing use of advanced surveillance capabilities against democratic institutions. Source: https://citizenlab.ca/research/member-of-committee-investigating-spyware-hacked-with-pegasus/ #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Pegasus

posts.text: 🇧🇭 Bahrain: Threat Actor Claims Sale of FortiGate Administrative Access for Golden Tulip Bahrain A threat actor has advertised what they claim is full administrative access to the FortiGate security infrastructure used by Golden Tulip Bahrain. * The listing claims access to the organization's Fortinet management interface with super_admin privileges. * According to the post, the actor has visibility into administrator accounts, user groups, VPN configurations, firewall policies, network objects, and application-control profiles. * The advertisement suggests the access is current ("fresh") and is being offered privately to interested buyers. * At the time of publication, there is no public confirmation from Golden Tulip Bahrain or Fortinet that validates the authenticity of the claim. posts.text_zh: 🇺🇸 Mailshake 據稱遭到破壞；威脅行為者聲稱擁有多年的內部分析數據 威脅行為者列出了他們聲稱屬於 Mailshake 的內部分析數據集，Mailshake 是一個用於冷電子郵件外展和 B2B 潛在客戶開發的銷售參與平台。 * 該攻擊者聲稱該資料集包含 2021 年 6 月至 2026 年 7 月期間收集的 229,519 則事件記錄。 * 該清單公佈了 538 個唯一的管理員電子郵件地址、735 個唯一的電子郵件帳戶、約 3,200 個使用者 ID、約 4,800 個裝置 ID 和大約 18,500 個唯一的 IP 位址。 * 根據該帖子，資料包括管理員活動日誌、活動事件、登入記錄、訂閱狀態、裝置資訊、時間戳記和其他操作元資料。 * 截至發佈時，Mailshake 尚未公開確認所稱違規行為的真實性。分析師註釋：內部遙測和分析資料可以為攻擊者提供有價值的操作情報，包括管理員身分、基礎設施詳細資訊和使用者行為。然而，地下市場的聲明應被視為未經驗證，直到受影響的組織進行獨立驗證或確認。 #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Mailshake

posts.text: 🚨Threat Actor Claims Breach of 3.1M Spanish Pensioner Records from INSS A threat actor has posted a listing on an underground forum claiming to possess a database containing the personal and financial details of over 3 million pensioners in Spain. The post alleges that the data was stolen from the Instituto Nacional de la Seguridad Social (INSS), the country's national social security institute, after extortion attempts failed. According to the forum listing, the breach involves 3,184,288 records exported in JSON format. The actor claims to have used "TerciosRAT" malware to access the system. The exposed dataset reportedly includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and financial data for each individual, including: * Full names * DNI (National Identity Document) numbers * Dates of birth * IBAN (International Bank Account Number) details * Home addresses * Landline and mobile phone numbers * Email addresses * Number of children The INSS is a critical government entity in Spain, responsible for managing social security benefits for millions of citizens. A compromise of this scale would expose a significant portion of the elderly population to identity theft, financial fraud, and targeted phishing attacks. The actor stated that they attempted to extort payment to prevent the leak but proceeded with the sale after receiving no response. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by INSS or Spanish cybersecurity authorities.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱違反了 INSS 的 310 萬西班牙退休金領取者記錄 一名威脅行為者在地下論壇上發布了一份清單，聲稱擁有一個資料庫，其中包含西班牙超過 300 萬名退休金領取者的個人和財務詳細資訊。該貼文聲稱，在勒索企圖失敗後，該國的國家社會保障機構 Instituto Nacional de la Seguridad Social (INSS) 的資料被盜。根據論壇列表，此外洩涉及以 JSON 格式匯出的 3,184,288 筆記錄。該攻擊者聲稱使用「TerciosRAT」惡意軟體來存取系統。據報道，暴露的數據集包括每個人的敏感個人識別資訊 (PII) 和財務數據，包括： * 全名 * DNI（國家身份證件）號碼 * 出生日期 * IBAN（國際銀行帳號）詳細信息 * 家庭住址 * 固定電話和手機號碼 * 電子郵件地址 * 兒童數量 INSS 是西班牙的一個重要政府，社會保障福利。這種規模的妥協將使很大一部分老年人口面臨身份盜竊、金融詐欺和有針對性的網路釣魚攻擊。該演員表示，他們試圖勒索付款以防止洩密，但在沒有收到回應後繼續進行銷售。截至本報告發布之時，INSS 或西班牙網路安全機構尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 1 Billion Meituan User Records for Sale A post on an underground forum claims that a database containing over 1 billion user records from Meituan, one of China’s largest digital platforms for local services, is available for purchase. The actor alleges that the data consists of records of Chinese citizens within the Meituan ecosystem and lists the price at $2,500. According to the listing, the database includes: * Over 1 billion total records * User data from the Meituan platform Meituan is a critical infrastructure component in China's digital economy, operating as a dominant super-app for food delivery, hotel bookings, ticketing, and other local services. The company serves hundreds of millions of active users and processes billions of transactions annually. If authentic, the exposure of such a massive volume of personal data could have significant privacy implications for Chinese citizens and potentially violate strict local data protection regulations. The post provides a sample file hosted on http://biteblob.com to verify the authenticity of the leak but does not specify the exact types of personally identifiable information (PII) contained within the full dataset, such as names, phone numbers, or addresses. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Meituan or third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱出售 10 億個美團用戶記錄 地下論壇上的一篇帖子聲稱，可以購買包含中國最大的本地服務數位平台之一美團的超過 10 億條用戶記錄的資料庫。該行為者聲稱，這些數據包含中國公民在美團生態系統內的記錄，並列出價格為 2,500 美元。根據清單，該資料庫包括： * 超過 10 億筆總記錄 * 來自美團平台的使用者資料 美團是中國數位經濟的重要基礎設施組成部分，是食品配送、飯店預訂、票務和其他本地服務的主導超級應用程式。該公司為數億活躍用戶提供服務，每年處理數十億筆交易。如果屬實，如此大量的個人資料的暴露可能會對中國公民的隱私產生重大影響，並可能違反嚴格的當地資料保護法規。該貼文提供了一個託管在 http://biteblob.com 上的範例檔案來驗證洩漏的真實性，但沒有指定完整資料集中包含的個人識別資訊 (PII) 的確切類型，例如姓名、電話號碼或地址。截至發稿時，美團或第三方安全研究人員尚未對涉嫌違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Sale of 263k Portuguese Healthcare Records from CUF A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor is offering for sale a dataset allegedly containing over 263,000 records from CUF, one of Portugal’s largest private healthcare groups. The listing, posted on an underground marketplace, claims the data includes sensitive patient contact information, demographic details, and internal unit structures. According to the post, the dataset is organized into three distinct categories: * **Contacts**: Includes full names, NIF (tax identification numbers), email addresses, phone numbers, physical addresses, postal codes, birthdates, genders, and job titles. * **Samplecollectioninstructions**: Contains client IDs, tax IDs, and specific instructions for sample collection linked to localities. * **Customerunits**: Lists client-unit associations, addresses, phone numbers, and fax numbers. The actor alleges that the data provides a "clear view of Portugal's relevant sector" and includes fields such as customer_code, created_by, and account_tier. A sample of the data was provided via a paste service link in the original thread. The seller reportedly accepts escrow or middleman services for the transaction. CUF (Centro de Saúde e Formação) is a major player in the Portuguese healthcare industry, operating numerous hospitals and health centers across the country. If authentic, the exposure of patient tax IDs, health-related sample instructions, and personal contact details could facilitate identity theft, targeted phishing campaigns, or further intrusion into the organization's infrastructure. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by CUF or security researchers.

posts.text: 🚨 Amazon Links Open-Source Supply Chain Campaign to North Korean Threat Actor Amazon Threat Intelligence has attributed a series of recent open-source supply chain attacks to a North Korea (DPRK)-linked threat actor, connecting multiple compromised NPM packages to the same campaign for the first time. * Amazon identified a DPRK-linked threat actor behind several recent compromises of popular NPM libraries. * The campaign targeted widely used open-source packages, increasing the potential downstream impact across software supply chains. * Researchers describe how attackers are leveraging generative AI to create more convincing malicious packages and are beginning to probe AI-assisted coding ecosystems. * The report highlights that software repositories remain a high-value target for nation-state actors seeking broad access through trusted dependencies. * Amazon urges organizations to strengthen dependency monitoring, package verification, and software supply chain security practices. Analyst Note: This research reinforces that open-source ecosystems remain a strategic target for nation-state operations. As AI accelerates software development, defenders should expect increasingly sophisticated package impersonation, dependency poisoning, and developer-focused supply chain attacks. Source: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/amazon-identifies-north-korean-hacker-group-behind-open-source-supply-chain-attacks/ #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #NorthKorea
posts.text_zh: 🚨 亞馬遜將開源供應鏈活動與北韓威脅行為者聯繫起來 Amazon Threat Intelligence 將最近發生的一系列開源供應鏈攻擊歸因於與北韓 (DPRK) 相關的威脅行為者，首次將多個受感染的 NPM 軟體包與同一活動聯繫起來。 * 亞馬遜發現了一個與北韓有關的威脅行為者，該威脅行為者最近對流行的 NPM 庫造成了幾次危害。 * 該活動針對廣泛使用的開源軟體包，增加了整個軟體供應鏈的潛在下游影響。 * 研究人員描述了攻擊者如何利用生成式人工智慧來創建更具說服力的惡意包，並開始探索人工智慧輔助編碼生態系統。 * 該報告強調，對於透過可信賴依賴關係尋求廣泛存取的民族國家行為者來說，軟體儲存庫仍然是一個高價值目標。 * 亞馬遜敦促組織加強依賴監控、套件驗證和軟體供應鏈安全實踐。分析師註：這項研究強調了開源生態系統仍是民族國家運作的策略目標。隨著人工智慧加速軟體開發，防禦者應該預見日益複雜的套件模擬、依賴中毒和以開發人員為中心的供應鏈攻擊。來源：https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/amazon-identizes-north-korean-hacker-group-behind-open-source-supply-chain-attacks/ #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #NorthKorea

posts.text: I was indeed paid to post this, although not very much. I liked the core concept of what they wanted to do. I think the people behind it are chill. My monies was given to me because I have stinky nerd street cred. This university research place which is trying to understand "hackers", or whatever, got monies from some place to study stinky nerds. These non-nerds were like, "well, they do crime, surely hackers and stuff have a similar psychology to other criminals". They quickly learned however that cyber criminals are FAR more paranoid than regular criminals. With regular criminals, like a drug dealer or something, you can usually approach them and try to talk. It makes it easier because you can physically see them. With cyber criminals on the other hand, it is extremely difficult to approach them because they're (usually) hyper-paranoid and (usually) have extreme anti-government and/or anti-authority beliefs. Additionally, unlike a majority of criminals, cyber-criminals place great importance on intellectualism and meritocracy. When this university place tried to approach hackers, they were coming in as anonymous nobodies who had no merit and no background in anything technical. As the many nerds who follow this social media profile know, people who put out work, produce work, or do SOMETHING are (usually) treated well (or better) or given respect. It is kind of like, stinky nerd street cred. Anyway, they found vx-underground and asked for my help to push the study. They ascertained I had stinky nerd street cred and hoped I could help them. Whenever they tried on their own they were called racial slurs, told to fuck off, were ignored, or called feds (or all of these combined). tl;dr stinky internet nerds not think like like criminals, have different philosophies on stuff
posts.text_zh: 我確實得到了發文的報酬，雖然不是很多。我喜歡他們想做的事情的核心概念。我認為背後的人很冷靜。我的錢之所以給我，是因為我有臭書呆子的街頭信譽。這個大學研究機構試圖了解「駭客」或其他什麼，從某個地方獲得資金來研究臭書呆子。這些非書呆子會說，「好吧，他們犯罪，駭客之類的人肯定與其他罪犯有類似的心理」。然而，他們很快就了解到，網路犯罪分子比普通犯罪分子更加偏執。對於普通罪犯，例如毒販或其他人，您通常可以接近他們並嘗試交談。這讓事情變得更容易，因為你可以親眼看到它們。另一方面，對於網路犯罪分子來說，接近他們是極其困難的，因為他們（通常）極度偏執並且（通常）有極端的反政府和/或反權威信念。此外，與大多數犯罪分子不同，網路犯罪分子非常重視理智主義和精英主義。當這所大學試圖接觸駭客時，他們只是以無名小卒的身份進來，沒有任何優點，也沒有任何技術背景。正如許多關注此社交媒體資料的書呆子所知，那些投入工作、生產工作或做某事的人（通常）會受到良好（或更好）或尊重。這有點像是臭書呆子的街頭信譽。不管怎樣，他們找到了 vx-underground 並請我幫忙推動這項研究。他們確定我有臭書呆子的街頭信譽，並希望我能幫助他們。每當他們自己嘗試時，他們都會被稱為種族誹謗，被告知滾蛋，被忽視，或被稱為聯邦調查局（或所有這些的總和）。 TL；臭網路書呆子不像罪犯那樣思考，對事物有不同的哲學

posts.text: As many people know, there is a thing called the "Terrible Twos". It is called this because toddlers have big emotions, but are incapable of expressing their frustration or regulating their emotions. This is a more complex task their brains haven't fully formed yet. Although it is called the "Terrible Twos", it isn't necessarily two years old, is ranges from slightly before being two years old, all the way to almost three years old. I'm happy to share my son has had his first few tantrums. Just kidding, I'm not happy, it actually fucking sucks. I told my son he couldn't play with his toy and he LOST HIS MIND. He was completely inconsolable. He threw himself to the floor, screaming at the top of lungs like he was being dismembered, didn't want us to hold him or touch him, refused his snacks or comfort food, bro LOST HIS MIND. Then he slowly calmed down... and it stopped. Dawg, toddler tantrums fucking suck ass so much omfg it's actually the worst and it's super stressful
posts.text_zh: 很多人都知道，有一種東西叫做「可怕的兩歲」。之所以這樣稱呼，是因為幼兒的情緒很強烈，但無法表達他們的挫折感或調節他們的情緒。這是一項更複雜的任務，他們的大腦尚未完全形成。雖然被稱為“可怕的兩歲”，但不一定是兩歲，範圍是從兩歲前一點，一直到快三歲。我很高興與大家分享我兒子的前幾次發脾氣。開個玩笑，我不高興，真的很糟糕。我告訴我兒子他不能玩他的玩具，他失去了理智。他完全傷心欲絕。他撲倒在地板上，大聲尖叫，就像他被肢解一樣，不想讓我們抱他或碰他，拒絕給他零食或安慰食物，兄弟失去了理智。然後他慢慢平靜下來……就這樣停止了。天哪，小孩發脾氣真是太糟糕了，天哪，這實際上是最糟糕的，而且壓力超級大

posts.name: vxunderground
posts.text: Y'know, peace and love to my fellow stinky nerds, but someone really needs to sit down and explain to people what exact RCE means. The acronym Remote Code Execution implies code (the beep boop stuff) is remotely (far away) executed (ran on the computer). Hence, beep boop stuff that is far away runs on a computer. Historically an RCE is like, your computer is running Soup Goop server, and Soup Goop server fails to properly parse data it receives, allowing specially crafted input to trick Soup Goop server to execute code. So, you could like, use Python 3.11 to send some dumb slop to a remote computer address and it'll execute your bad stuff. In this instance (and many other from Steam and malicious mods in general), the idea is that someone operates or possesses a server which, and when a player joins, the video game server syncs data to the newly connected host which pushes a payload to it. In simple language, and as a hypothetical example, I operate Stinky Minecraft server, and if you join Stinky Minecraft server, my Stinky Minecraft server automatically pushes mods to your computer. Stinky Minecraft server does this because it automatically ensures you're compatible with Stinky Minecraft server and we can all play and have fun. However, one day Stinky Minecraft server says, "you need Goop Texture Pack Mod 0.2.1.1 and ... INFORMATION STEALING MALWARE HEHEHEHEHE" and that malware is automatically pushed to your machine (also with Goop Texture Pack Mod 0.2.1.1). Things like this doesn't really fit the category of Remote Code Execution because nothing is being executed remotely as a vulnerability, it requires a victim machine to connect to a malicious host which syncs the payload to the machine. This is closer in terminology to arbitrary code loading, malicious plugin loading, remote installation of untrusted code ... something, I don't know, but it's not an RCE. Overall, this is more or less a fundamental flaw in the design of video game mods because they're not appropriately sandboxed.
posts.text_zh: 你知道，對我的臭書呆子同胞來說，和平與愛，但有人真的需要坐下來向人們解釋 RCE 的確切含義。縮寫「遠端程式碼執行」意味著程式碼（嘟嘟的東西）是遠端（遠處）執行的（在電腦上運行）。因此，遠方的 beep boop 東西會在電腦上運行。從歷史上看，RCE 就像您的電腦正在運行 Soup Goop 伺服器，而 Soup Goop 伺服器無法正確解析它接收到的數據，從而允許特製的輸入欺騙 Soup Goop 伺服器執行程式碼。因此，您可以使用 Python 3.11 向遠端電腦位址發送一些愚蠢的內容，它會執行您的壞東西。在這種情況下（以及來自 Steam 和惡意 mod 的許多其他情況），其想法是有人操作或擁有一個伺服器，當玩家加入時，視訊遊戲伺服器將資料同步到新連接的主機，然後向其推送有效負載。用簡單的語言來說，作為一個假設的例子，我運行 Stinky Minecraft 伺服器，如果您加入 Stinky Minecraft 伺服器，我的 Stinky Minecraft 伺服器會自動將 mod 推送到您的電腦。 Stinky Minecraft 伺服器這樣做是因為它會自動確保您與 Stinky Minecraft 伺服器相容，並且我們都可以玩得開心。然而，有一天，Stinky Minecraft 伺服器說，“你需要 Goop Texture Pack Mod 0.2.1.1 和…資訊竊取惡意軟體嘿嘿嘿嘿”，並且該惡意軟體會自動推送到你的電腦（也包含 Goop Texture Pack Mod 0.2.1.1）。像這樣的事情並不真正適合遠端程式碼執行的類別，因為沒有任何東西作為漏洞被遠端執行，它需要受害者機器連接到惡意主機，該惡意主機將有效負載同步到機器。這在術語上更接近任意程式碼載入、惡意插件載入、遠端安裝不受信任的程式碼……我不知道，但它不是 RCE。總的來說，這或多或少是電玩模組設計中的一個根本缺陷，因為它們沒有適當的沙盒化。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 3M Mondial Relay Records Leaked on Darkweb A post on an underground forum claims the release of a database containing over 3 million records belonging to Mondial Relay, a major French parcel delivery and logistics service. The actor alleges that the data was extracted in December 2025 and is now available for download in JSON format. According to the listing, the exposed dataset includes sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) and detailed shipping logs for customers. The sample data provided in the thread reveals the following fields: * Full names of recipients * Residential addresses * Mobile phone numbers * Parcel tracking numbers and shipment IDs * Pickup point locations ("pointRelais") * Sender details, including names of major e-commerce retailers such as Zalando, Cdiscount, Fnac, and La Redoute * Detailed tracking history with timestamps and status updates Mondial Relay is a significant player in the European logistics sector, operating thousands of pickup points across France and other countries. The company handles millions of parcels annually for major online retailers, making its customer database a high-value target for identity theft and fraud. If authentic, the exposure of this volume of PII could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns or social engineering attacks against affected consumers. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or confirmed by Mondial Relay.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱 3M Mondial Relay 記錄在暗網上洩露 地下論壇上的一篇帖子聲稱，包含法國主要包裹遞送和物流服務 Mondial Relay 的超過 300 萬條記錄的數據庫被洩露。該攻擊者聲稱資料是在 2025 年 12 月提取的，現在可以 JSON 格式下載。根據清單，暴露的資料集包括敏感的個人識別資訊（PII）和客戶的詳細運輸日誌。帖子中提供的樣本數據顯示以下字段： * 收件人全名 * 住宅地址 * 手機號碼 * 包裹跟踪號碼和貨件 ID * 取件點位置（“pointRelais”） * 發件人詳細信息，包括 Zalando、Cdiscount、Fnac 和 La Redoute 等主要電子商務零售商的名稱 * 帶有時間和狀態更新的詳細跟踪歷史記錄是歐洲物流領域的重要參與者，在法國和其他國家經營數千個取貨點。該公司每年為主要線上零售商處理數百萬個包裹，使其客戶資料庫成為身份盜竊和詐欺的高價值目標。如果真實，暴露大量 PII 可能會促進針對受影響消費者的有針對性的網路釣魚活動或社會工程攻擊。截至本報告發佈時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到安全研究人員的獨立核實或 Mondial Relay 的確認。

posts.name: MonThreat
posts.text: 🚨 YouNow User Database Allegedly Leaked on Darkweb Forum A darkweb forum post claims that the full user database of YouNow, a live streaming platform, has been compromised and is being circulated underground. According to the listing, the breach exposes approximately 3.96 million user records in JSON and CSV formats. The actor alleges that the data was obtained from a massive breach occurring in 2026, though independent verification of this specific incident timeline is currently lacking. The post details an extensive array of personally identifiable information (PII) and technical metadata included in the dump. The alleged exposed data fields include: * **Personal Identifiers:** User ID, Username, Email, First Name, Last Name, Gender, Age, Birth Date, Country, and Profile URL. * **Social & Account Links:** Facebook ID, Google ID, Twitter ID, Social Tokens (Facebook/Google), and Connected Social Networks. * **Technical & Device Data:** IP Addresses (HTTP X-Forwarded-For & Remote Addr), Device Information (iOS/Android, Device ID, UUID), App Version, OS Version, and Devices List. * **Activity & Moderation Metrics:** Registration Date, Last Login Date, Broadcast Count, Total Fans, Spending History, Moderation Flags (Smyte/Sift Scores), and Admin Role Permissions. YouNow is a VC-funded company with reported revenues exceeding $50 million, operating a global platform for live video streaming. The exposure of social tokens and IP addresses could potentially facilitate targeted phishing campaigns or account takeovers if the tokens remain valid. The forum post includes sample records showing users from the US, Canada, and Turkey, with registration dates dating back to 2017. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach and the authenticity of the 3.96 million record database have not been independently verified by security researchers or confirmed by YouNow.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 暗網論壇上的 YouNow 用戶資料庫據稱遭洩露 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱直播平台 YouNow 的完整用戶資料庫已被洩露並正在地下傳播。根據清單，此次洩漏暴露了約 396 萬筆 JSON 和 CSV 格式的使用者記錄。該行為者聲稱這些數據是從 2026 年發生的一次大規模洩漏中獲得的，儘管目前缺乏對該特定事件時間線的獨立驗證。該貼文詳細介紹了轉儲中包含的大量個人識別資訊 (PII) 和技術元資料。據稱暴露的資料欄位包括： * **個人識別碼：** 使用者 ID、使用者名稱、電子郵件、名字、姓氏、性別、年齡、出生日期、國家/地區和個人資料 URL。 * **社交和帳戶連結：** Facebook ID、Google ID、Twitter ID、社交令牌 (Facebook/Google) 和連結的社交網路。 * **技術和設備資料：** IP 位址（HTTP X-Forwarded-For 和遠端位址）、裝置資訊（iOS/Android、裝置 ID、UUID）、應用程式版本、作業系統版本和裝置清單。 * **活動和審核指標：** 註冊日期、上次登入日期、廣播計數、粉絲總數、支出歷史記錄、審核標誌（Smyte/Sift 分數）和管理員角色權限。 YouNow 是一家由創投資助的公司，報告收入超過 5000 萬美元，經營著一個全球直播視訊串流平台。如果令牌仍然有效，社交令牌和 IP 位址的暴露可能會促進有針對性的網路釣魚活動或帳戶接管。該論壇貼文包含的樣本記錄顯示來自美國、加拿大和土耳其的用戶，註冊日期可追溯到 2017 年。截至報告發佈時，涉嫌違規行為以及 396 萬筆記錄資料庫的真實性尚未得到安全研究人員的獨立驗證或 YouNow 的確認。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 10M French Health Records Leaked from http://Ameli.fr A darkweb forum post reveals the alleged exposure of a massive database containing over 9.8 million records from http://Ameli.fr, the primary online portal for France’s national health insurance system. The actor claims to have published the leak on July 28, 2026, describing it as the "http://Ameli.fr Provider Registry" for that year. According to the listing on the underground forum, the compromised dataset is highly structured and focuses on healthcare professionals rather than patient medical histories. The post enumerates the following types of exposed data: * Professional identifiers (national ID numbers and professional registration codes) * Personal details (title, first name, last name) * Medical specializations and profession codes * Workplace and establishment identifiers (SIRET, SIREN, FINESS) * Organizational and clinic information * Full addresses and location data * Contact details (telephone, fax, email where available) * Administrative classifications and regulatory codes The file size is reported to be 1.98 GB (2,128,933,147 bytes). http://Ameli.fr is operated by Assurance Maladie, part of the Caisse Nationale de l'Assurance Maladie des Travailleurs Salariés (CNAMTS), which manages health coverage for millions of French citizens. While the leak reportedly targets provider data, the exposure of contact information and establishment IDs for nearly 10 million entities could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns or social engineering attacks against the French healthcare infrastructure. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from the French health insurance authority.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱 1000 萬條法國健康記錄從 http://Ameli.fr 洩露 一篇暗網論壇帖子揭露了一個包含超過 980 萬條記錄的大型數據庫，該數據庫來自法國國家健康保險系統的主要在線門戶網站 http://Ameli.fr。該演員聲稱於 2026 年 7 月 28 日發布了洩漏信息，並將其描述為當年的“http://Ameli.fr 提供商註冊表”。根據地下論壇上的列表，受損的資料集高度結構化，重點是醫療保健專業人員而不是患者病史。該貼文列舉了以下類型的暴露資料： * 專業識別碼（國民身分證號碼和專業註冊代碼） * 個人詳細資料（頭銜、名字、姓氏） * 醫療專業和職業代碼 * 工作場所和機構識別碼（SIRET、SIREN、FINESS） * 組織和診所資訊 * 完整地址和位置資料 * 聯絡資訊（電話、傳真） （2,128,933,147 位元組）。 http://Ameli.fr 由 Assurance Maladie 經營，該公司是 Caisse Nationale de l'Assurance Maladie des Travailleurs Salariés (CNAMTS) 的一部分，負責管理數百萬法國公民的健康保險。據報道，雖然此次洩露的目標是提供者數據，但近 1000 萬個實體的聯絡資訊和機構 ID 的暴露可能會促進針對法國醫療基礎設施的針對性網路釣魚活動或社會工程攻擊。截至撰寫報告時，所指控的違規行為尚未得到安全研究人員的獨立核實，也沒有得到法國健康保險機構的官方聲明。

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Leak of Indian Missile Data on Darkweb Forum A post on an underground forum alleges the exposure of sensitive technical data related to India's Akash weapon system and Akash Prime missile. The actor, operating under the username 'slepra', published the listing on July 28, 2026, claiming to possess internal documentation or specifications for these defense systems. The Akash missile family is a critical component of India's air defense infrastructure. Developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and manufactured by Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), the system is widely deployed by the Indian Armed Forces and has been exported to several countries, including Armenia and Russia. The Akash Prime is an upgraded variant designed with improved range and anti-jamming capabilities. The forum post does not provide specific details regarding the volume of data, the format of the files, or the method used to obtain the information. No screenshots or sample documents were included in the provided intelligence to verify the authenticity of the claim. If authentic, the exposure of technical specifications for active military hardware could pose significant national security risks, potentially aiding adversaries in developing countermeasures. However, such claims on darkweb forums are frequently exaggerated or fabricated to attract attention or solicit payments. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach of Akash missile data has not been independently verified by security researchers or official government sources.

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Persistent Access to Saudi Government Ecosystem A darkweb forum post reveals that a threat actor is offering persistent administrative access to a government ecosystem in Saudi Arabia. The listing, posted on July 27, 2026, alleges the compromise of multiple critical infrastructure components, including an admin panel, backend API keys, and active SAML signing certificates. According to the post, the actor claims to have obtained full access to a MySQL database containing sensitive government records. The alleged data exposure includes: * 100,271 government email addresses * Full names of associated individuals * Hashed passwords * GOV GMAIL SMTP access * SMS API keys * Secondary backend access to a connected http://gov.sa subdomain The actor describes the breach as providing "persistent administrative access" to a government panel, suggesting long-term control over the compromised systems rather than a one-time data exfiltration. The inclusion of SAML signing certificates and SMS API keys indicates potential for further lateral movement or identity-based attacks within the broader government network. Saudi Arabia's digital government infrastructure has been a target for various cyber threats in recent years, with critical sectors including energy, finance, and public administration frequently scrutinized for security vulnerabilities. A breach of this scale, if authentic, could enable significant intellectual property theft, infrastructure targeting, and large-scale phishing campaigns using legitimate government credentials. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Saudi authorities or independent security researchers. #DataBreach #SaudiArabia #GovernmentHack #SAML #DarkWeb #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱持續訪問沙烏地阿拉伯政府生態系統 暗網論壇貼文顯示，威脅行為者正在提供對沙烏地阿拉伯政府生態系統的持續管理存取權。該清單發佈於 2026 年 7 月 27 日，聲稱多個關鍵基礎設施元件遭到洩露，包括管理面板、後端 API 金鑰和活動 SAML 簽章憑證。根據該帖子，該演員聲稱已獲得對包含敏感政府記錄的 MySQL 資料庫的完全存取權。據稱的資料外洩包括： * 100,271 個政府電子郵件地址 * 相關個人的全名 * 散列密碼 * GOV GMAIL SMTP 訪問 * SMS API 密鑰 * 對連接的 http://gov.sa 子域的輔助後端訪問 攻擊者將此次洩露描述為向政府面板提供“持久管理訪問”，表明對受一次性系統的長期洩露。 SAML 簽章憑證和 SMS API 金鑰的包含表明在更廣泛的政府網路中存在進一步橫向移動或基於身分的攻擊的可能性。近年來，沙烏地阿拉伯的數位政府基礎設施一直是各種網路威脅的目標，能源、金融和公共管理等關鍵部門經常受到安全漏洞的審查。如果這種規模的違規行為屬實，可能會導致嚴重的智慧財產權盜竊、基礎設施攻擊以及使用合法政府憑證的大規模網路釣魚活動。截至本報告發佈時，沙烏地當局或獨立安全研究人員尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。 #DataBreach #SaudiArabia #GovernmentHack #SAML #DarkWeb #Cyber​​Security #ThreatIntelligence

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims Massive Data Breach of Egyptian Football Association A threat actor known as Revesky claims to have leaked the entire database of the Egyptian Football Association (EFA), exposing sensitive personal information for approximately 350,000 players. posts.text: 🚨 Obsidian Claims 1.5M User Records Leaked on Darkweb Forum A darkweb forum post alleges that the Obsidian note-taking application has suffered a significant data breach, exposing the personal and account information of more than 1.5 million users. The listing, published recently, includes a sample CSV file containing hashed passwords, email addresses, usernames, and financial details related to subscription plans. According to the post, the leaked dataset contains the following fields: * user_id * email * password_hash (bcrypt format) * username * country_code and country * email_verified status * account_created date * catalyst_license and purchase dates * sync_plan, billing_cycle, and expiration dates * publish_sites and associated billing details * commercial_seats and expiration * obsidian_credit and lifetime_spend_usd * newsletter_opt_in preference * account_status * last_login_at timestamp * registration_ip address The sample data provided in the thread shows users from various countries, including the United States, China, Germany, Canada, and Turkey. The records include both free users and those with paid "plus" or "standard" subscriptions, revealing their total lifetime spending in US dollars. The password hashes appear to be in bcrypt format ($2y$), which is generally considered secure against rapid cracking but still poses a risk if users have reused passwords across other services. Obsidian is a popular local-first markdown note-taking app known for its privacy-focused approach, as user data is typically stored locally on devices rather than in the cloud. However, this alleged breach targets the central authentication and billing database used for Obsidian Sync and Publish services. If authentic, the exposure of email addresses and IP addresses could facilitate targeted phishing campaigns against the user base. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Obsidian or third-party security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 Obsidian 聲稱 150 萬用戶記錄在暗網論壇上洩露 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱，Obsidian 筆記應用程序遭受了重大數據洩露，超過 150 萬用戶的個人和帳戶信息被洩露。最近發布的清單包括一個範例 CSV 文件，其中包含雜湊密碼、電子郵件地址、用戶名以及與訂閱方案相關的財務詳細資訊。根據該帖子，洩漏的資料集包含以下欄位：* user_id * email * password_hash（bcrypt格式）* username * country_code和country * email_verified status * account_created date * Catalyst_license和購買日期*sync_plan、billing_cycle和expiration * Catalyst_license和購買日期*sync_plan、billing_cycle和expiration7175%*和購買日期*的資訊和相關日期的細節和相關日期obsidian_credit和lifetime_spend_usd * newsletter_opt_in偏好* account_status *last_login_at 時間戳 *registration_ip 位址 線程中提供的範例資料顯示了來自不同國家的用戶，包括美國、中國、德國、加拿大和土耳其。這些記錄包括免費用戶和付費「附加」或「標準」訂閱的用戶，以美元顯示他們一生的總支出。密碼雜湊值似乎採用 bcrypt 格式 ($2y$)，這種格式通常被認為可以安全地防止快速破解，但如果使用者在其他服務中重複使用密碼，仍然會帶來風險。 Obsidian 是一款流行的本地優先 Markdown 筆記應用程序，以其註重隱私的方法而聞名，因為用戶資料通常儲存在本地設備上而不是雲端。然而，此次涉嫌違規的目標是用於 Obsidian 同步和發布服務的中央身份驗證和計費資料庫。如果真實，電子郵件地址和 IP 位址的暴露可能會促進針對用戶群的有針對性的網路釣魚活動。截至報告時，黑曜石或第三方安全研究人員尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 404Crew Claims Breach of UAE Government Identity Agency A darkweb forum post by the threat actor group 404Crew Cyber Team alleges the successful compromise of a United Arab Emirates government agency responsible for identity, citizenship, visa, and residence permit procedures. The post, dated July 25, 2026, claims that the group has breached the website of this official state entity, which handles critical national identification and immigration data. The targeted organization is likely the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP) or a related emirate-level authority such as the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA). These agencies manage the digital infrastructure for millions of residents and citizens in the UAE, processing sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII), biometric data, and legal status records. According to the listing on the underground forum, the 404Crew Cyber Team is asserting responsibility for the incident. No specific details regarding the volume of stolen data, the type of vulnerability exploited, or any ransom demands were included in the initial announcement. The actor did not provide proof of compromise or sample data in the thread. If authentic, a breach of a UAE government identity provider would represent a significant security incident due to the high sensitivity of citizenship and residency records. Such data is highly valuable for identity fraud and espionage. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or official statements from UAE authorities. #DataBreach #UAE #GovernmentHack #404Crew #IdentityTheft #CyberSecurity

posts.text: 🚨 Threat Actor Claims 1.95M Records Leaked from Spanish Foreign Ministry via IDOR A threat actor claims to have exfiltrated 1,953,721 records from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation of Spain (MAEC) by exploiting an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability. According to a post on an underground forum, the attacker used advanced penetration testing to identify exposed routes within the HTML code of a specific request, allowing them to iterate through numerical identifiers and access user profile data. The post alleges that the breach targeted the ministry's main database, which is powered by the Liferay Digital Experience Platform (DXP) running on Apache/2.4.53 with OpenSSL/3.0.1. The actor claims to have extracted sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) for nearly two million users, including: * Full names and primary/secondary email addresses * Phone numbers and full physical addresses * Birth dates and nationalities * Document types and document numbers (e.g., passports) * Internal IP addresses and CSRF authentication tokens * User IDs and screen names The leaked data reportedly includes profiles from citizens of various countries, such as Pakistan, Brazil, Venezuela, Peru, Algeria, and Cuba, indicating the global scope of the ministry's digital services. The actor provided proof-of-concept JSON snippets showing detailed user records, including internal network addresses like "172.19.1.100". The data dump is allegedly available for sale at $1,500 in JSON format, totaling 2.45 GB. The post lists several exposed endpoints related to authentication, administration, OAuth2 services, and API resources, suggesting significant misconfiguration in the portal's access controls. If authentic, this exposure could enable identity theft and phishing campaigns targeting individuals registered with Spanish diplomatic services. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by security researchers or the Spanish government.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 威脅行為者聲稱透過 IDOR 從西班牙外交部洩露了 195 萬筆記錄 威脅行為者聲稱透過利用不安全直接物件引用 (IDOR) 漏洞從西班牙外交部、歐盟和合作部 (MAEC) 洩露了 1,953,721 條記錄。根據地下論壇上的一篇帖子，攻擊者使用高級滲透測試來識別特定請求的 HTML 程式碼中暴露的路由，從而允許他們迭代數位識別碼並存取用戶配置檔案資料。該貼文稱，此次外洩針對的是該部的主要資料庫，該資料庫由運行在 Apache/2.4.53 和 OpenSSL/3.0.1 上的 Liferay 數位體驗平台 (DXP) 提供支援。該攻擊者聲稱已提取了近 200 萬用戶的敏感個人識別資訊 (PII)，包括： * 全名和主要/次要電子郵件地址 * 電話號碼和完整實際地址 * 出生日期和國籍 * 證件類型和證件號碼（例如護照） * 內部 IP 地址和 CSRF 身份驗證令牌 * 用戶 ID 和屏幕名稱據報道，洩漏的數據包括巴基斯坦、巴西、委內瑞拉、秘魯、阿爾及利亞和古巴等各國公民的個人資料，顯示該行為的全球範圍。部的數位服務。該攻擊者提供了概念驗證 JSON 片段，顯示詳細的使用者記錄，包括「172.19.1.100」等內部網路位址。據稱，該數據轉儲採用 JSON 格式，售價 1,500 美元，總計 2.45 GB。該貼文列出了與身分驗證、管理、OAuth2 服務和 API 資源相關的多個暴露端點，顯示入口網站存取控制中存在嚴重的設定錯誤。如果屬實，這種暴露可能會導致針對在西班牙外交部門註冊的個人的身份盜竊和網路釣魚活動。截至本報告發布之時，安全研究人員或西班牙政府尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。

posts.text: 🚨 Alleged Gulfjobs Breach Exposes 872k Candidate Records on Darkweb A darkweb forum post claims that approximately 872,000 records from the Saudi Arabian job portal Gulfjobs have been leaked, exposing detailed personal and professional information of job seekers. The listing alleges that the data includes user registration details, authentication logs, and extensive third-party platform mappings across three distinct categories. According to the post, the compromised dataset contains 50 unique data fields divided into the following sections: * **Contacts:** Personal details including email addresses, full names, dates of birth, mobile and landline phone numbers, street addresses, nationality, marital status, and LinkedIn profiles. * **Candidate Profiles:** Sensitive background information such as passport numbers, passport issue/expiry dates, total work experience, health problems, physical disabilities, weight, height, police clearance certificates, current and expected salaries, and resume file paths. * **Job Applications:** Recruitment metadata including applied job titles, application statuses, interview results, offer statuses, background check results, visa status, onboarding status, and internal recruiter notes. Gulfjobs is a prominent online recruitment platform in the Middle East, serving as a key resource for job seekers and employers in Saudi Arabia and the wider region. The exposure of passport numbers and health data raises significant privacy concerns for the affected individuals. The actor behind the leak provided verification links via Gofile and requested transactions through a neutral escrow service. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by Gulfjobs or security researchers.
posts.text_zh: 🚨 涉嫌洩密的 Gulfjobs 在暗網上洩露了 872,000 條求職者記錄 一篇暗網論壇帖子聲稱，沙特阿拉伯求職門戶網站 Gulfjobs 的約 872,000 條記錄已被洩露，暴露了求職者的詳細個人和專業信息。該清單稱，這些數據包括用戶註冊詳細資訊、身份驗證日誌以及跨三個不同類別的廣泛第三方平台映射。根據該帖子，受損的資料集包含 50 個獨特的資料字段，分為以下部分： * **聯絡人：** 個人詳細信息，包括電子郵件地址、全名、出生日期、手機和固定電話號碼、街道地址、國籍、婚姻狀況和 LinkedIn 個人資料。 * **候選人簡介：** 敏感的背景信息，例如護照號碼、護照簽發/到期日期、總工作經驗、健康問題、身體殘疾、體重、身高、無犯罪記錄證明、當前和預期工資以及簡歷文件路徑。 * **職位申請：** 招聘元數據，包括申請的職位名稱、申請狀態、面試結果、錄取通知狀態、背景調查結果、簽證狀態、入職狀態和內部招聘人員說明。 Gulfjobs 是中東地區著名的線上招聘平台，是沙烏地阿拉伯及更廣泛地區求職者和雇主的重要資源。護照號碼和健康資料的暴露給受影響的個人帶來了嚴重的隱私問題。洩漏事件背後的攻擊者透過 Gofile 提供驗證鏈接，並透過中立託管服務請求交易。截至本報告發布之時，Gulfjobs 或安全研究人員尚未對所指控的違規行為進行獨立核實。
